item.title: Kavdeh wildlife refuge: A biodiversity hotspot in northern Iran
item.description: Spanning approximately 74,000 hectares in Firuzkuh County, Kavdeh wildlife refuge is home to a wide variety of wildlife and birds of prey. Located at the ecological boundary between the Hyrcanian forests and the Irano-Turanian vegetation zone, the refuge supports diverse animal and plant species, highlighting the importance of conservation efforts to protect its natural habitats.

Spanning approximately 74,000 hectares in Firuzkuh County, Kavdeh wildlife refuge is home to a wide variety of wildlife and birds of prey. Located at the ecological boundary between the Hyrcanian forests and the Irano-Turanian vegetation zone, the refuge supports diverse animal and plant species, highlighting the importance of conservation efforts to protect its natural habitats.

item.title: Canada backing UAE claim on Iranian islands violates UN Charter principles: FM spox
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Foreign Ministry spokesperson Esmaeil Baqaei condemns Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney’s support for the United Arab Emirates’ claim over three Iranian islands in the Persian Gulf, calling it a blatant contradiction and a flagrant violation of the principles enshrined in the United Nations Charter.
